I found out why you're losing.  You're generating a LAP file.  If you
compile without making a LAP file, you'll win.  This is because DEFVST
puts hunks in the eval-mungeables which are destined for the FASL
file, and nobody ever went to the trouble of making LAP understand
HUNKs.  When I compiled your file TEST 10, even on AI which has the
not-quite-up-to-date version of DEFVST, I had no problem with 
(STRUCT-TYPEP (FOO)).
